blocks.text: 306 808 E 8th Avenue Mount Pleasant VE Vancouver V5T 1T5

parts.t: Welcome to this charming junior 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo located on the top floor, offering added privacy and quiet. Enjoy bright living spaces and treetop views in the heart of vibrant Mount Pleasant, just steps from Broadway. Ideal for investors or first-time buyers, this home is part of a well-managed building undergoing a $4.5 million revitalization—including full envelope and membrane replacement—ensuring long-term value and peace of mind. Recent upgrades include a new elevator, roof, and piping. Comes with 1 parking stall, a storage locker, and is pet-friendly. A fantastic opportunity in an unbeatable location!
